To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the prevalence rate of musculoskeletal disorders in blacksmiths in Bantaran District was 100%, 2) the most frequently affected body part was the lower back, 3) the most frequently reported symptoms were lower back pain and shoulder pain, 4) the most frequently experienced pain severity was moderate, 5) the highest risk score was 20, and 6) there was a correlation between the risk level and the level of complaints experienced by workers.

the most common musculoskeletal disorders are neck, back and shoulder pain, and that the main factors influencing musculoskeletal disorders in blacksmiths are working posture, age, smoking and working hours.
the prevalence of MSDs in the foundries was 100% with a medium pain level and a medium risk level.

the risk level of MSDs and its influencing factors among workers of blacksmiths in Bantaran Subdistrict.

the most important factors causing MSDs were the working position and other supporting factors, such as age, work experience, and smoking.
there are many factors that influence the musculoskeletal disorders in the blacksmiths in Bantaran Sub-district.
the musculoskeletal disorders that occurred among workers in the smithy center of Bantaran Subdistrict, Probolinggo Regency was due to poor work posture, long work hours, and the habit of smoking.
